title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E06 — Snake in the Pants
A man gets stuck in a chimney while trying to rob a house; pet store owners catch a thief with stolen snakes in his pants; a man breaks into an escape room and can't escape.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E07 — Golf Streaker
A man streaks across a golf course, delaying a tournament; a dead fish is eerily placed on the front porch of a house; two men climb the Golden Gate Bridge; an escapee gets caught in a very weird place.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E08 — Hanging on the Hood
A man hangs on the hood of his car while his ex-girlfriend drives it on the highway; an intoxicated woman flees from airport police on a motorized suitcase; a man take a selfie with his daughter inside an elephant enclosure at the zoo.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E09 — Doorbell Licker
An aspiring rapper is arrested after performing on top of a billboard; a man is caught licking the doorbell intercom of a home; a detained shoplifting suspect escapes her handcuffs and steals a police car.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E10 — Scary Wedding
A suspect flees from a high-speed car chase while carrying her infant child; state troopers catch a man with a stolen utility pole strapped to the roof of his car; a catering hall owner flips out on wedding guests.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S01 E12 — Takeout Drugs
A man leads police on a high-speed chase in a stolen mail truck; a restaurant owner is arrested after hiding drugs in a takeout box; a pizza delivery guy helps the cops arrest a thief.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E01 — I Have to Poop!
A desperate woman needs to poop during a traffic stop; a mom is busted sneaking into a school dressed as her daughter; a man jumps into a store's 24,000-gallon aquarium and more.

title: My Strange Arrest
description:
S02 E02 — Ride or Die
An innocent woman insists on going to jail with her arrested friend; a thief runs away with a giant life-size stick figure; a fleeing suspect gets trapped in a porta-potty.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S04 E05 — Southern Belle From Hell and My Best Friend's Girl
The brutalized body of a female student is found on the University of Tennessee campus; a young man disappears in Texas.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S04 E10 — Ready, Set, Action & What Happens in Vegas ...
A girl falls victim to two high-school classmates, who film what they believe is their murderous path toward immortality; when a teen tries to break away from a group of aspiring mobsters, he becomes their first victim.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S04 E12 — Rumors & The To-Do List
A teenager with schizophrenia decides that it is his mission to kill everyone in the world; a cheerleader is killed in Orinda, Calif.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S02 E03 — Foul Ball & Framed
An 8-year-old vanishes without a trace; a teen is set up and slaughtered to death by his friends.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S02 E04 — Thrill Kill & Poisoned
A girl goes missing, and the perpetrator turns out to be a 15-year-old thrill killer; a teenager poisons her grandmother with no apparent reason.

title: Killer Kids
description:
S04 E13 — Tattle Tale Terror & Army Brat
When their parents disapprove of a teenage couple, the outcome is homicidal leaving a family in tatters; a lonely, young girl is befriended by a group of disaffected teens.

description:

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E07 — Love and Hate
Near what's known as the hanging tree, the mutilated body of Timothy Coggins is found in late 1983; the investigation is thwarted, and the case freezes for over 30 years, until a newly elected sheriff vows to bring the killers to justice.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E08 — Ice Cold in Denver
In 1980, radio intern Helene Pruszynski is found brutalized in a snowy field; after 37 years of fruitless leads, investigators tap into a public genealogy website that leads them across the country to the killer they've been hunting.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E09 — Murder by Moonlight
On Easter Sunday of 1992, the body of missing woman Lisa Ziegert is found in a field; the investigation yields many leads, but no true suspect; after more than two decades on ice, the case is revived when DNA phenotyping puts a face to the killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E10 — Suspicious Minds
Just after the last day of school in 1984, 15-year-old Reesa Trexler is found murdered in her grandparents' home; for decades, a stalled investigation only fuels the town rumor mill, pointing an accusing finger at Reesa's 13-year-old sister, Jodie.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E24 — 'Til Death Do Us Part
Just two years into their marriage, Chuck and Cheryl Hall are torn apart when Chuck finds Cheryl murdered; though Cheryl's family is certain they know her killer, the law isn't as sure; decades later, a DNA match erases all doubt.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E25 — The Lost Patient
In 1979, Janie Landers disappears from a home for the impaired; when Janie's body is found, there are many suspects, but it is years before the killer and the atrocities in the facility are revealed.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S02 E26 — Missing and Murdered
When Cree woman Shirley Soosay goes missing in 1980, her niece Violet promises her grandmother that she will bring Shirley home; Violet never dreamed the search for Shirley -- and justice -- would take a lifetime.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S02 E07 — Joshua Aide
Joshua Aide is on trial for the murder of his ex-girlfriend's father, as well as her attempted murder and that of a family friend. He claims he was ambushed by the three who were plotting to kill him and cash in on his life insurance policy.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S02 E06 — Cristhian Bahena Rivera
When a young college student disappears on her evening run, investigators scour her small town searching for her; when her accused attacker takes the stand, the story becomes more complicated than expected.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S02 E02 — Adam Matos
When an entire family is found in a decaying pile of bodies by the side of a Florida road, the hunt is on to find what police fear might be two more victims; a man and his son are found alive, launching a bizarre investigation.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S02 E03 — Nancy Brophy
Romance novelist Nancy Brophy faces life in prison for the murder of her husband; she is set to testify in her own defense and her attorneys launch a full-fledged effort to paint her as a creative.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S02 E05 — Lynlee Renick
When Ben Renick is found dead in his snake facility, law enforcement assumes he is a victim of one of his snakes -- until the coroner finds bullet casings hidden behind shelves; three years of investigation eventually lead police to Ben's wife.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S02 E01 — Danielle Redlick
Stay-at-home mom Danielle Redlick is charged with the murder of her husband, pro sports executive Michael Redlick; after holding onto her account for nearly three years, Danielle finally takes the witness stand and her story takes a turn.

title: Taking the Stand
description:
S02 E04 — Curtis Reeves
Curtis Reeves stands accused of murdering Chad Oulson over popcorn at a matinée movie; the defense claims he acted in self-defense while the state's prosecutors argue that Reeves was short-tempered and unjustified in the shooting.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E08 — Murder in Myrtle Beach
Shock runs through a community when a wealthy businessman is found murdered in South Carolina.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E09 — Serial Killer on the Run
After decades on the run, a serial killer faces tough questions in the interrogation room; after a woman is found dead in the middle of the road, the finger pointing begins when three suspects are interviewed.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E10 — The Murder of Rambo
In 2012, 26-year-old Timothy Rambo Ramsey is killed in a drive-by shooting, but the investigation yields little evidence, and the case goes cold for six years; when detectives re-examine the evidence, they uncover a violent feud between two men.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E11 — Test of Faith
Investigators respond to a local hospital where an elderly woman fights for her life after a brutal assault; the victim is able to describe the vicious assault; quick detective work points the officers to a suspect, but he stonewalls detectives.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E12 — A Mother's Touch
When an otherwise healthy young woman is admitted to the hospital with sudden organ failure, an anonymous tip leads authorities to investigate a pattern of unexplained deaths in her family and a shocking prime suspect.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E13 — A Deadly Drink for Dad
When an 85-year-old man passes away after years of failing health, authorities quickly rule it a natural death and close the case; years later, a bombshell recording reveals that those closest to him may have played a hand in his passing.

title: Interrogation Raw
description:
S02 E14 — Three's a Crowd
Ten years after a young mother allegedly abandoned her family, her mother-in-law reveals a shocking secret: she believes both of her daughter-in-law's lovers murdered her.
